# My Landlord Certificate

> My Landlord Certificate is a UK landlord compliance platform that lets landlords, HMO operators and letting agents book property safety certificates online. Accredited engineers are dispatched across all 33 London boroughs and the surrounding M25 area, and certificates are emailed within 24 hours (Fire Risk Assessment reports within 48 hours). Prices are fixed and shown before booking — no call-out charges or hidden fees.

## About

- Company: My Landlord Certificate Ltd
- Coverage: London and the M25 area — all 33 London boroughs
- Turnaround: certificate emailed within 24 hours (Fire Risk Assessment report within 48 hours)
- Pricing: fixed prices, shown before you pay; no call-out charges
- Accreditations: NICEIC approved, NAPIT registered, ELECSA, Gas Safe Registered, Elmhurst Energy / Stroma accredited DEAs, NEBOSH / IFSM / IFE / BAFE fire-safety assessors
- Address: 134 Merton High St, London SW19 1BA
- Phone: 020 3996 1070
- Email: info@mylandlordcertificate.co.uk
- Booking: online in under 3 minutes; tenant or keyholder can provide access (landlord need not be present)

## Services

- [EICR (Electrical Installation Condition Report)](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/eicr): Domestic electrical safety certificate, valid up to 5 years, NICEIC/NAPIT engineers. From £67.99.
- [Gas Safety Certificate (CP12)](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/gas-safety-certificate): Annual gas safety check by Gas Safe Registered engineers.
- [EPC (Energy Performance Certificate)](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/epc): A–G energy rating by accredited DEAs, lodged on the national register within 24 hours, valid 10 years. From £89.99.
- [Fire Risk Assessment](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/fire-risk-assessment): Written FRA for HMOs and blocks of flats under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, by NEBOSH/IFSM assessors. Report within 48 hours. From £74.
- [Fire Safety Certificate (smoke & CO alarm testing)](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/fire-safety-certificate): Smoke, heat and CO alarm testing to BS 5839-6. From £54.99.
- [PAT Testing](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/pat-testing): Portable appliance testing for rental properties and HMOs. From £59.99.
- [Commercial EICR](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/commercial-eicr): Electrical condition report for commercial premises, priced per consumer unit. From £149.99.
- [Commercial EPC](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/commercial-epc): EPC for offices, retail and commercial lets.
- [Commercial Gas Safety (CP42)](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/commercial-gas-safety-certificate): Gas safety certification for commercial premises.
- [Landlord Certificate Bundles](https://www.mylandlordcertificate.co.uk/landlord-certificates-bundle): EICR + Gas Safety + EPC + FRA bundles for landlords and HMOs. From £130.
